title: yamaa independent public performance input and item-10 budgets
description: Auditor reads original public-performance/1 and public-performance-campaign/1 evidence only. Paths are relative to the manifest, including a self-contained source Git bundle for offline replay. Original absolute runner paths remain immutable identity strings. --check-collection requires harness correctness, native source admission, all 567 candidate tuple/case combinations and 504 required comparator role/case combinations, forbids budgets, and preserves budgets:not_evaluated and accepted:false. Each tuple requires 18 prior Python lookup/aggregate/window cases and six producer-root-Build cases on the same observed runner. Unexpected/duplicate role cases refuse; missing required comparators cannot become policy unavailable dispositions. R retains Python comparator observations while cross-host ratios remain incomparable. Final --check additionally requires original terminal successful completion and approved numeric budgets. No release thresholds are provided by this schema. Post-completion --catalog derives whole/segmented reader units from all 21 original tuples. --unit selector.json --check-unit replays complete unchanged raw evidence and retains accepted:false/no-budgets fragments. aggregate_public_performance.py requires genuine independently fetched reviewed reader job/run/attempt/artifact proof, exact nondeduplicated 567+504 cells and recomputed original raw-vector statistics. --check-collection still never supplies numeric acceptance. Final budget acceptance additionally requires exact original reader completion; canceled/failed original or reader attempts refuse. The measured one-case scheduling pilot does not establish whole-matrix runtime. Full original performance/native/reader API artifact snapshots remain immutable, including older same-named attempts. Eligibility and ambiguity are determined separately inside the exact selected successful producing-job interval; explicit original artifact IDs/names/source/run remain bound. Old-attempt substitution and duplicate artifacts inside the selected interval refuse. Both Python and R may use nine approved dimension-variant segments per original logical tuple, retaining complete three-size cases and matching same-runner comparator distributions. All21 tuples segmented derive189 reader units while candidate567/comparator504 identities and all original44-sample records stay unchanged. Legacy whole and mixed scheduling remain valid. Observed pilot pressure motivates scheduling; it does not establish whole-matrix runtime or numeric budgets. The explicit --collection-scope linux-installed route implements issue #2288: 54 candidate cells with all original raw truth and 10 cold/3 warmup/30 warm samples, installed Linux Python 3.12 wheel plus R 4.6.1 source, optional separately validated comparators and no numeric budgets. Default full-matrix audits remain unchanged.

path.description: Retained relative path; absolute paths, traversal and symlink escapes are refused by the auditor.

completion_run.description: Separately obtained original selected-run-attempt API snapshot after terminal success. Preserve run.json unchanged. Required for final acceptance when the original snapshot was in_progress; different source/run/attempt or terminal failure is refused.

collection_scope.description: Explicit collection-only scope. linux-installed requires 54 candidate cells (27 cases x installed Linux Python 3.12 wheel and R 4.6.1 source), retains all independent raw truth/sampling/native checks, does not require prior-release comparators and forbids numeric budgets. The auditor CLI must select the same scope; omission preserves the full original 21-tuple audit.

input.description: run/artifacts/jobs contain original Actions API snapshots for the selected performance.yml run attempt, with digest fields omitted. Successful actual producing jobs and artifact/campaign timestamps bind the attempt. An in-progress workflow snapshot can supply a collection-only gate when its named producers have succeeded; final acceptance requires a separate completion_run receipt for that same original attempt. Failed/cancelled attempts remain refused. Missing jobs fail admission. source_bundle is a self-contained Git bundle containing candidate, baseline, harness and generator truth revisions; otherwise --repository supplies pinned source. Full Actions admission requires native_run/native_jobs/native_artifacts original API snapshots for the exact successful native attempt. The auditor reuses the full native admission protocol, verifies each tuple native-run.json and the existing github-actions:<run>/attempt-<attempt>/<artifact>/<filename> reference, and records original native artifact IDs. Absent native proof remains unavailable and cannot pass; local raw-collection sample replay makes no Actions qualification claim.

rule.description: Exactly one rule must cover every observed candidate median. Values use nanoseconds/bytes for absolute comparison or a dimensionless compatible Python candidate/baseline ratio. Producer root-Build and cross-host R/Python observations never establish full-lifecycle or RSS ratios. One warm RSS measurement describes the actual whole warm child, including warmups and transport. Phase values sum original entered/completed offsets for each phase across actual nodes; phases can contain other phases and are not additive wall-time partitions. phase.held_save_1/2 use actual owner-local held Save intervals, separately from host boundaries.

disposition.description: Exactly one recorded item-10 disposition must cover every required unavailable/incomparable metric. metric may be a fnmatch pattern, e.g. baseline:*. Known noncomparative gaps include phase_durations, actual_callback_counts, isolated_process_startup, shipped_schema_initialization and os_filesystem_cache. Missing baseline medians use baseline:<metric>. Callback totals and phase function counts remain exact correctness observations.

budgets.description: Explicit source-specific decision input. Absent or unapproved budgets produce not_evaluated; malformed budgets fail their own gate without replacing harness/coverage verdicts. There are no accepted numeric thresholds implied by collector booleans or this schema.

artifact_id.description: null retains a visible missing matrix tuple; it cannot pass.

plain_entry.description: archive optionally names an original Actions ZIP. The auditor safely expands only this tuple and removes private copies before advancing. Without archive, original unpacked evidence is read in place.

artifact_id.description: null retains a visible missing matrix tuple; it cannot pass.

segment.description: One approved Python or R dimension variant, with all three row sizes and complete 10 cold/3 warmup/30 warm plus truth sampling per case on its original actual runner. Python artifact performance-python-{os}-{python}-{form}-{variant} and job performance-python ({os}, {python}, {form}, {variant}); R artifact performance-r-{os}-source-{variant} and job performance-r ({os}, source, {variant}). Applicable role collections contain exactly these candidate cases, plus matching prior lookup/aggregate/window baseline cases or producer-root-Build cases. No distribution or RSS child observation is split or pooled across runners.

segmented_entry.description: Optional Python and R scheduling: exactly one segment for each of nine approved dimension variants, with non-overlapping complete cases. Every segment retains all three row sizes and complete original sampling plus its matching baseline roles on one actual runner. Legacy whole entries remain valid. Auditor refuses duplicate/missing/unapproved variants and wrong role/case coverage. Logical coverage stays21 tuples,567 candidate cells and504 required comparator cells; all segmented yields189 independent reader units.

measurement_scopes.description: Descriptive report metadata only; original cold/warm metric names, raw values, clocks, sampling and distributions remain unchanged. Boundary descriptions apply to cold.<boundary>.median_ns and warm.<boundary>.median_ns where observed.

boundaries.package_import: Actual package/runtime import once per fresh child; isolated process startup is unavailable. Warm import is not assigned to each repetition.
boundaries.public_build: Actual public domain/Build invocation on the declared lifecycle. Producer root-Build reference is a separate root-evaluator scope.
boundaries.copied_output: Public output getter plus complete canonical typed-frame construction: schema, rows, cells, binary64, i64 and date representations. Subsequent JSON/gzip checkpoint writes are outside this timer.
boundaries.copied_issues: Public issues getter plus canonical issues conversion; subsequent JSON/gzip checkpoint writes are outside this timer.
boundaries.copied_verification_log: Public verification-log getter plus canonical typed-frame conversion when present; subsequent JSON/gzip checkpoint writes are outside this timer.
boundaries.copied_warning_log: Public warning-log getter plus canonical typed-frame conversion when present; subsequent JSON/gzip checkpoint writes are outside this timer.
boundaries.metadata_after_build: Collector package/version/origin metadata reads after Build.
boundaries.held_save_1: Actual first held public Save invocation; reached-report capture and saved-byte retention follow outside this timer.
boundaries.held_save_2: Actual repeated held public Save invocation; reached-report capture and saved-byte retention follow outside this timer.

const.phase_durations: Original owner-local stage durations summed by phase across the retained nested-node ledger. Inclusive nested sums are not additive wall-time partitions. Native output_preparation is a Build phase; it is separate from the copied_output getter-plus-canonical-construction boundary.
const.owner_held_save_intervals: Original owner-local completed_ns minus entered_ns for each retained held Save interval, reported as phase.held_save_1/2 separately from outer held_save_1/2 timers.
const.child_peak_rss: Actual whole-child-lifetime process peak, including collector work outside boundary timers. Cold has ten fresh-child observations; warm has one whole warm-child observation across all three warmups and thirty measured repetitions. No per-repetition RSS values or cross-runner pooling are invented.
const.outside_outer_timers: Original report/measurement transport, JSON/gzip checkpoint serialization, saved-byte copying and controller acceptance remain outside outer call/canonical-conversion timers. No overhead subtraction or timing repair is applied.
const.baseline_ratios: Compatible ratios require Python candidate and prior Python 0.3.0 observations on the same actual runner with the same lookup/aggregate/window scope. R-to-Python ratios remain incomparable. Producer root-Build is a separate comparator scope from full-graph Build, Save and child RSS.

unit_selector.description: One original whole tuple or approved complete Python/R dimension variant. Source, artifact, paths, case lists and roles cannot be overridden. The auditor derives every selection from the complete original manifest.

artifact_id.description: null retains a visible missing matrix tuple; it cannot pass.

flat_segment.description: One approved Python or R dimension variant, with all three row sizes and complete 10 cold/3 warmup/30 warm plus truth sampling per case on its original actual runner. Python artifact performance-python-{os}-{python}-{form}-{variant} and job performance-python ({os}, {python}, {form}, {variant}); R artifact performance-r-{os}-source-{variant} and job performance-r ({os}, source, {variant}). Applicable role collections contain exactly these candidate cases, plus matching prior lookup/aggregate/window baseline cases or producer-root-Build cases. No distribution or RSS child observation is split or pooled across runners.

fragment.description: A complete reader unit preserves original measured/native/harness identities and all declared case/role raw metric vectors and actual function/callback ledgers after independent typed raw validation. Local fragments have no authenticated Actions identity and cannot qualify the aggregate. No fragment supplies numeric acceptance.

aggregate_input.description: Original complete successful performance manifest and separately fetched actual reader run/job/artifact API snapshots. Fragment ZIP root members are performance-unit-audit.json/.md; each exact artifact ID/name/size/creation interval binds to successful performance-replay-unit (<selector-key>) in .github/workflows/performance-replay.yml at trusted --reviewed-auditor-revision. Duplicate/missing units or original tuple-case-role cells refuse. Raw-vector statistics/counts/scopes are recomputed without pooling. Original and reader snapshots stay immutable; numeric acceptance requires separate exact terminal-success receipts for both. A later reviewed aggregate checkout may differ from the original qualified reader revision. Trusted reader events/branches are workflow_run at main or push at evidence/issue-1998-replay. Numeric evidence qualification is distinct from migration closure: the current aggregate/finalizer cannot self-attest eventual success; actual terminal-success run/job/artifact and durable-retention proof must be fetched independently after completion.
